It is retrospective and semantic rather than lexical, and it does not fire on positive-polarity synonyms of the same state (open, available, free), on ordinary event negation (did not buy), on hedges or vague quantities (about, perhaps, a few), on plain durations (the entire summer), on containers holding a physical substance (the bottle was empty) or on settled negative states (closed, dead, lost, failed).
